title: Household budget template
subject: Computing
source: Written for computing/y9 lesson 15 (Household budget template (portal, invented figures))
intro: Lesson 15: Project: a household budget model. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

model.title: Save for a £1,200 laptop with the £500 balance, keeping £200 for emergencies

keywords.def: a plan for income and spending
obligatory charity on wealth above the nisab, 2.5% a lunar year
a 'what if' version of the plan

questions.q: Bills rise by 10% (from £300). New bills and new balance?
Build the budget model (portal template): income, expenses, balance formula, a savings target and two scenarios; write a recommendation.
questions.a: A working model with scenarios and a recommendation.

questions.q: Extend: add a chart of spending by category.
Stretch: add a zakah calculator: 2.5% of savings above an example nisab.
Think again: Why might a family with a good income still run out of money each month?
questions.a: Without a plan, small spends add up; a budget shows where money goes.
